description: This PHP source file defines the HomePageService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to retrieve default paths for various modules and the homepage, utilizing a trait for user role management.

classes.name: HomePageService
classes.description: Service class that provides methods to retrieve default URLs for various modules and the homepage, based on user roles.

methods.name: getHomePagePath
methods.description: Returns the homepage path for the current user, or null if not available.
